name: tia_delete_plc_type
description: Delete one PLC data type (UDT) by exact, case-sensitive name. TIA Portal decides whether the delete is allowed and its answer is reported; blocks, DBs and other UDTs that used the type become inconsistent until changed, so compile afterwards. Program blocks are deleted with tia_delete_block. Only the PLC software's own folders are searched; objects inside S7-1500 software units are out of scope.

type_name.description: Exact name of the PLC data type (UDT) to delete.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

group_path.description: Exact type-folder path, e.g. 'HMI/Manual'. Omit to search all folders; an empty string means the root folder only.
